newsitem.title: GERMANY: TENNIS-HINGIS PULLS OUT OF HAMBURG AFTER RIDING ACCIDENT.
newsitem.headline: TENNIS-HINGIS PULLS OUT OF HAMBURG AFTER RIDING ACCIDENT.

text.p: World number one Martina Hingis has pulled out of next week's women's tennis tournament in Hamburg because of a knee injury sustained in a riding accident, the German Tennis Federation (DTB) said on Wednesday.

The DTB said Hingis had fallen from a horse on Monday evening. The injury was minor but ruled her out of both the Hamburg event due to begin next Monday and the Italian Open in Rome the following week.
It was not yet clear whether the 16-year-old Swiss would be fit in time for the German Open in Berlin on May 12, the DTB said in a statement.

Hingis, a keen horsewoman, escaped injury earlier this year when she landed on soft grass after falling from a horse on the eve of her quarter-final match in the Australian Open. She went on to win the tournament.
